recordedAgainst.note: Two recordings per program. Run-window times, execution durations, page and transaction tokens (also where an answer echoes a token the request carried) and the project id are placeholders; the project id is recorded as demo-fs-query-index in every lane. Missing-index links keep their encoded index with the project id replaced. `second` holds the other recording of rows that differed.
